node.title: HGE4 non-full near-square straight-line lift
node.statement: For D=S^2-a^2, the divisor condition D | X^n-1 has an exact cubic repeated-squaring presentation. Adding sum_(j=1)^(h-1) z_j s_j=1 captures every non-full-fiber near-square divisor, including free and swap primitive unions; equivalently use h-1 inverse charts. With k=log_2(n)-floor(log_2(2h-1)), the global selector has k(4h-1) variables and k(4h-1)+1 equations, while one chart has k(4h-1)-h+2 variables. The schemes are empty in characteristic zero and have integer bad-characteristic certificate endpoints. No certificate, survivor count, or uniform aggregate is claimed.
